title: Singleton Fourier coefficient and influence
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ be monotone in the coordinatewise order, and choose a coordinate $i\\in\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$. Then the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at the singleton $\\{i\\}$ equals the probability, under the uniform distribution on the cube, that flipping coordinate $i$ changes the value of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$i$ is a coordinate in the cube
